# Containment Tenure

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ContainmentTenure`](gmeow-ContainmentTenure.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ContainmentTenure>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The reified, time-scoped fact that a place was contained in a larger place over an interval — for boundary changes, re-organisations, and disputed parallel parents. Reifies [`containedInPlace`](../properties/gmeow-containedInPlace.md) over time; the plain transitive property remains the flat shortcut.
